reviews.name: Divya Krishnamurthy
reviews.text: My entire bridal trousseau was from Ethnic Elegance. The Kanchipuram saree I wore was a family heirloom in the making. The styling advice was invaluable.

reviews.name: Shobha Rao
reviews.text: I've been buying from here for six years. The quality of silk and authenticity of weave is unmatched in Jayanagar. These are pieces my daughter will inherit.

reviews.name: Nikhita Jain
reviews.text: Got my reception lehenga here. The embroidery was exquisite and they custom-fitted it perfectly. Compliments didn't stop all night!

reviews.name: Arvind Hegde
reviews.text: Bought my wedding sherwani and engagement kurta set here. Excellent fabric, perfect fit and very fair pricing. Will definitely return.

reviews.name: Meera Iyer
reviews.text: Their everyday salwar suits collection is beautiful and affordable. The staff genuinely help you pick what suits you, never pushy. My go-to boutique.

faq.a: Yes, all our sarees come with complimentary blouse stitching. Lehengas and salwar suits can be custom-stitched to your measurements at no extra charge.
We offer exchanges within 7 days of purchase for unworn items with tags intact. Custom-stitched items are not eligible for return.
Yes, we ship pan-India via insured courier. COD is available for orders under ₹50,000. International shipping is available on request.

faq.q: Do you have a bridal consultation?
faq.a: Absolutely. Our senior stylists offer a complimentary bridal consultation where we curate options based on your wedding theme, complexion and budget.

faq.q: What price range are your sarees?
faq.a: Our collection starts from ₹2,499 for daily-wear cottons and goes up to ₹2,00,000+ for exclusive bridal silks. There's something for every occasion and budget.
